subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical core fix for plugin tool availability diagnostics, accepting its warn-only handling of plugin-authored availability-like metadata without SDK/docs changes, or choose a narrower sibling implementation instead?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proof-positive, but the permanent contract boundary is a maintainer choice because plugin loader behavior that affects plugin authors is compatibility-sensitive and two sibling PRs still overlap the same issue.

options.title: Accept this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this PR after maintainer review as the canonical warn-only fix, then close or decline the overlapping candidate PRs for the same issue.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling PR
options.body: Select a smaller open candidate if maintainers prefer less plugin resolver/cache surface area, then close this PR as superseded after that path is safe.

options.title: Require SDK/docs alignment first
options.body: Ask for the plugin tool availability contract to be documented or exposed before merge if maintainers want this to become a public plugin-author surface now.

recommendation.title: Accept this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this PR after maintainer review as the canonical warn-only fix, then close or decline the overlapping candidate PRs for the same issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mostly about plugin descriptor/cache and plugin loader contract ownership, where this person has the strongest recent history signal.
